name: S08 apparatus proposal: tuned-liquid cell for the Silva-Lora and Torres Fig. 9b singlet

status_meaning.modelled: Present in the S08 numerical model with the values quoted in the drawing (read from the design state)
status_meaning.proposed: Needed to build the apparatus; not represented in any simulation yet

components.label: Cylindrical cell bore
components.spec: Inner radius equal to the pinning radius 2.02 mm (lens clear radius 2.0 mm); rigid walls except the source surfaces; windows 0.8 mm beyond the lens vertices

components.label: Three liquid layers
components.spec: Brine (1030 kg/m3) below, NOA 61 (uncured) in the middle, light oil (850 kg/m3) above; properties are declared assumptions in configs/shared/noa61-brine-oil-assumption.json

components.label: Pinned contact lines at the lens rim heights
components.spec: Model: both contact lines fixed on the 2.02 mm ring at the heights of the published lens surfaces there. Hardware (proposed): two sharp circumferential edges at those heights

components.label: Window source surfaces
components.spec: Concentric annular regions on both windows; ideal normal-velocity sources with impedance-matched admittance

components.label: Wall source surface
components.spec: Axial bands on the bore wall

components.label: Drive command
components.spec: 1.5 MHz, one complex amplitude per source region from 26 continuous modes (design/source-commands.csv)

components.label: Optical conjugates
components.spec: Collimated input; image 6.43 mm beyond the front vertex (Fig. 9b scaled 1/14); traced with the published indices 1 / 1.7 / 1, i.e. the lens as cured, in air

components.label: Oil immiscible with uncured NOA 61, about 5 mN/m against it
components.spec: Not identified. Requirement from the meniscus fit; a surfactant may be needed. Measured densities and tensions replace the assumptions before any run is trusted

components.label: Transparent ring-electrode transducers as windows
components.spec: Transparency, electrode-gap diffraction and window refraction not modelled

components.label: Backing and matching layers
components.spec: Approximate the modelled admittance; per-channel calibration required

components.label: Fill and vent ports, syringe pumps
components.spec: One per layer; final trim by optical feedback

components.label: Temperature-controlled enclosure
components.spec: Thermal expansion and sound-speed drift not modelled here

components.label: Multichannel phase-controlled transmitter
components.spec: Continuous wave, independent amplitude and phase per channel

components.label: Collimated test beam
components.spec: LED, pinhole and collimating lens; entrance window not modelled

components.label: Image-plane sensor and wavefront sensor
components.spec: Spot and shape measurement for closed-loop trim

components.label: UV curing source
components.spec: Freezes the shaped resin; shrinkage, heating and demoulding are separate, unmodelled processes

scope: Proposal for hardware that realizes the S08 tuned-liquid numerical model; not a validated or built apparatus.
